$comment: Self-derived finetype drift contract for naturalearth/countries_110m, checked by the in-engine finetype_validate@1 gate (the model-free `ft_validate` DuckDB table macro). ft_validate MELTS every column to VARCHAR, so this contract uses ONLY the string-surviving JSON-Schema keywords. ENFORCED: the `pattern` on iso_a3 and iso_a2, the shapes countries_110m.overrides.json publishes; the closed `enum` on continent; a pattern that holds geom to a GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon object; and `minLength`/`maxLength` envelopes on the text. NOT ENFORCED, by design: NULLs (invisible to ft_validate) and object-level `required` (documentation only). Derived from build/stage/countries_110m.parquet on Natural Earth's release 5.1.1: a pass-through on today's rows, a fail-closed tripwire for future drift (a -99 left in a code, a geometry of another kind, a new continent).
title: naturalearth/countries_110m
